messages.subject: locator() like function for ggvis
parts:
Hi everyone,

I would like to be able to click on a point in a ggvis and act on the corresponding data line. The goal is to be able to plot raw data and add flags to erroneous data points.
The presence of tooltips show me that the link between position on the plot and data is already done somewhere.I would need to leverage this to get the line number or something equivalent. In base R that would be locator(), in ggplot that would be grid.locator() and some data massaging to get from npc coordinates to coordinates on the plot. If there any sort of equivalent in ggvis currently? Is it planned? Can someone point me in the right direction to look into this (or is it too early)?

Thanks in advance. Sincerely,
